usage: Common everyday noun for grass in gardens, parks, and countryside settings.
Often used for the grass area itself or as part of compound words like lawn and weed-related expressions.
Neutral and very common in spoken Cantonese; works well in simple descriptions of plants and outdoor spaces.
Learners should note that it refers to grass as a plant/material, not to a grassy field as a whole in every context.
